# Thüringer Landesamt für Statistik

> > Official statistical office of Thuringia providing comprehensive regional data, demographic analysis, and municipal statistics across all districts and counties.

The Thüringer Landesamt für Statistik (TLS) serves as Thuringia's authoritative source for official statistics, operating under the TMIKL ministry. It provides data on demographics, labor markets, economic indicators, and territorial administration across Thuringia's counties including Wartburgkreis, Kyffhäuserkreis, Ilm-Kreis, and major cities like Erfurt, Jena, and Gera.

## Key Topics

- Thüringer Landesamt für Statistik (TLS)
- Thuringia regional statistics
- Demographic change and population data
- Landkreise (counties): Wartburgkreis, Kyffhäuserkreis, Ilm-Kreis, Saale-Holzland-Kreis, Saale-Orla-Kreis, Unstrut-Hainich-Kreis, Weimarer Land, Altenburger Land, Gotha, Saalfeld-Rudolstadt, Greiz
- Major cities: Erfurt, Gera, Jena
- Gemeinden (municipalities) and administrative structures
- Erfüllende Gemeinden (fulfilling municipalities)
- Municipal database and territorial changes
- ThürNGG law and administrative reforms
- Statistical yearbooks and county profiles
- Labor market statistics
- Quality standards and EU code of practice
- Industrial and construction statistics
- Higher education data

## Core Statistical Services

- [Thüringer Landesamt für Statistik Homepage](https://statistik.thueringen.de): Homepage of Thuringia's statistical office with regional data & news
- [Demographic Change Data](https://statistik.thueringen.de/datenbank/demowandel.asp): Demographic change data: population, migration, age, households
- [About the Statistical Office](https://statistik.thueringen.de/amt/amt_inh.asp): Organizational structure of TLS statistical office under TMIKL ministry
- [Quality Standards](https://statistik.thueringen.de/amt/qualitaet.asp): Quality standards & EU code of practice for statistical data

## Statistical Reports & Analysis

- [Monthly Statistical Reports Archive](https://statistik.thueringen.de/analysen/Analyse2.asp): Statistical monthly reports archive on labor market & demographics

## Regional & Municipal Reference

- [Statistical Glossary & Terminology](https://statistik.thueringen.de/datenbank/defAuswahl.asp): Statistical glossary & terminology catalog for environmental data
- [Municipality Selection Tool](https://statistik.thueringen.de/datenbank/gemauswahl.asp): Municipality selection tool with codes for Erfurt, Gera, Jena & more
- [Territorial Changes & Mergers](https://statistik.thueringen.de/datenbank/gebiet2.asp): Territorial changes & municipality mergers under ThürNGG law
- [Fulfilling & Contracting Municipalities](https://statistik.thueringen.de/datenbank/gebiet7.asp): Database of fulfilling/contracting municipalities in Thuringia counties
- [Municipal Administration Relationships](https://statistik.thueringen.de/DatenBank/gebiet7.asp): Municipal administration relationships across Thuringia districts
- [Administrative Community Name Changes](https://statistik.thueringen.de/datenbank/gebiet8.asp): Administrative community name changes & regional codes in Thuringia
